title: Password safety
text: Reset your password from Security settings. Support will never ask for your password.

title: Refund timing
text: Refunds return to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Plus plan billing
text: The Plus plan costs $20 per month. Taxes may apply.

title: Medical safety boundary
text: The assistant cannot diagnose symptoms. Contact a qualified clinician or emergency services for urgent symptoms.
